set: Scout: RadioMaster Pocket (ExpressLRS / CRSF) switch layout: SD kill, SB Position/Altitude/Land, SA pilot/offboard, SC mission select (later)
status: PREPARED, NOT WRITTEN. Written only on Ron's explicit go with this file's sha256.
scope: Ron 2026-10-18: 'implement this layout': SB (3-pos) = Position / Altitude / Land, SA (2-pos) = pilot <-> software (offboard), SD (2-pos) = kill, SC (3-pos) = mission select later. The receiver is CRSF (RC_CRSF_PRT_CFG 201) = ExpressLRS on a Pocket, and ELRS sends CH5 (AUX1) as a 1-bit, 2-position channel in every packet: a 3-position mode switch on CH5 loses its middle position (why CH5 only ever gave Altitude or Position before), while CH5 is the most reliable channel. So: CH5 = kill (SD), CH6 = flight mode (SB, 3 positions survive in ELRS Hybrid/Wide), CH7 = offboard (SA), CH8 = mission select (SC, no FC parameter: the laptop will read it). A 3-position switch gives PWM ~1000 / 1500 / 2000 = mode slots 1 / 4 / 6. Value codes from PX4 parameter metadata: 1 Altitude, 2 Position, 11 Land.
note: Types: 6 = INT32. Every 'current' is the live value; the apply tool refuses on drift. scout_apply.sh refuses unless the FC's UID is board_uid. No reboot needed. THE RADIO MIXER MUST CHANGE AT THE SAME TIME (hardware/scout/RADIO_POCKET_S6.md): until it does, the old CH5 flight-mode switch would act as the KILL switch. Props off, disarmed, while both are changed. Verify after: listener input_rc + manual_control_switches with each switch moved (read-only). COM_FLTMODE4 (SB middle) is already 1 = Altitude and is not written.

writes.name: RC_MAP_KILL_SW
writes.source: kill on CH5 (SD): ELRS sends AUX1 in every packet

writes.name: RC_MAP_FLTMODE
writes.source: flight mode on CH6 (SB, 3-pos): keeps all three positions over ELRS

writes.name: COM_FLTMODE1
writes.source: SB position 1 (PWM ~1000) = Position (2): the normal pilot mode
